name: cavemio-feedback
title: Feedback
description: A score that changes the question: pick 0–10 or stars, the score rolls into the panel, and the follow-up and its tags fit what you picked.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The scale is a radio group named by the question: arrows and Home/End move it, number keys jump to a score, and each star is named (“4 stars, Good”).
- The chip and the light are decoration; the checked radio is the score. Tags are toggle buttons with aria-pressed.
- The thanks is a status region, so sending is announced once; an error is an alert under the button.
- Hover previews only follow a real mouse, so a tap on a phone never leaves a preview behind.
- Its light comes from your theme: the panel is --primary with a band of --primary-foreground that follows the score, the track an inset 1px edge. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Textarea, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion the score, stars and follow-up change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: – · Gets { score, band: "low" | "mid" | "high", tags, comment }; throw an Error to show its message.

props.name: question
props.description: "How likely are you to recommend us to a friend?" · The question on the panel.

props.name: scale
props.description: "nps" · 0–10 (0–6 low, 7–8 mid, 9–10 high), or one to five stars (1–2 low, 3 mid, 4–5 high).

props.name: prompts
props.description: – · The follow-up question and quick tags for each band.

props.name: ends
props.description: "Not likely", "Very likely" / "Poor", "Great" · Words under each end of the scale.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: – · Shows a close button on the panel.

useCases.title: NPS surveys
useCases.description: The 0–10 question in the app or an email landing page, with a follow-up that fits.

useCases.title: After an order
useCases.description: Stars for a delivery or a purchase, with tags for what went right or wrong.

useCases.title: In-app feedback
useCases.description: “How was this?” after a feature, a report or an AI answer.

useCases.title: Support follow-ups
useCases.description: Rating a resolved ticket, with the reason when it went badly.

features.title: Two scales
features.description: scale="nps" for 0–10, or "stars" for one to five with a word for each (Poor to Great).

features.title: A question for the score
features.description: Low, middle and high scores each get their own question and tags; set prompts to word them for your product.

features.title: The score you can feel
features.description: The thumb is thrown to it, the number rolls into the chip and the light follows; hovering previews before you commit.

features.title: Keyboard first
features.description: Arrow keys move the score and number keys jump straight to it; tags are toggle buttons.

features.title: Sent in place
features.description: onSubmit gets { score, band, tags, comment }; Send goes Sending → Sent and the form turns into the thanks.

features.title: Anywhere it’s shown
features.description: Compact enough for a card, a corner or an email landing page; onDismiss adds a close button.

states.title: ask
states.description: The lit panel with the question, a “?” chip and the scale in an inset track; the ends are labelled under it.

states.title: hover
states.description: With a mouse, the thumb previews the score you’re over at half strength and the chip rolls to it; leaving puts both back.

states.title: score
states.description: The thumb is thrown to the score (460ms with a slight overshoot), the chip’s number rolls, and the light along the panel’s top glides over it (620ms). Stars fill one after another (40ms apart) and the word under them morphs.

states.title: follow-up
states.description: The first score opens the follow-up (460ms); a score in another band clears the tags and brings the new question and tags in from the side the score moved, 35ms apart.

states.title: sending
states.description: Send feedback → Sending; tags and the comment are locked.

states.title: thanks
states.description: A check draws itself in the button, then the form turns into “Thanks, that helps.” with the score and tags, and the scale is locked.

states.title: error
states.description: If onSubmit throws, the button shakes into Try again and your message shows under it; nothing is lost.
